name: Dominic Alvarez
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember noticing my late husband's old account had never been closed.” Friday often includes a stop at Breakwater Way, where Dominic stops on the landward side of the cycle track to watch the first boats turn for home.
voice: I'm his old victim's sister. I offered to cover only the meals that went to people still alive.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a rust-colored canvas coat and a tiny red thread tied through the lowest buttonhole. Dominic has a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose, with a neat white crop. Dominic presses the lips together to keep a smile in during a conversation.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Dominic takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To pay only for the meals still doing somebody good.
family: Melle Juric is Dominic’s cousin’s child. Dominic calls back when there is finally a little privacy. Melle leaves the first voice message. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *An unfinished atlas*, Melle says, “My father remembers the coffee seller's face but loses names halfway through a sentence.”
connections: Eli Brady. A real signature matters to both the former forger and the person making a limited repayment.

reactions.situation: The deli is asked to publish the whole tab
reactions.response: Dominic asks who owns the personal information on the tab before any of it leaves the counter.

reactions.situation: A stranger offers money to cut ahead of an exhausted neighbor
reactions.response: Dominic tells the stranger when the next opening is, then stays with the neighbor until their turn comes.

reactions.situation: When a relative dismisses a little luxury
reactions.response: Dominic asks which ordinary pleasure the relative would give up first.
